text:
eli: Heads-up: multiple customers (acme, bluehawk) reporting p99 jumps ~+6-8s after Nebula v1.2 rolled. Long inputs (>8k tokens). Some 504s and a couple of auth errors showing 'invalid signature' on retries -> billing failures. Escalating.

alex: Thanks. Any repros / request ids? Can you paste the failing curl?

eli: Sample request id: 82c3f7b2. Repro curl below (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \n  -d '{"model":"nebula-v1.2","input":"<8k+ tokens...>"}'
```

maya: We did land a tokenizer merge change in v1.2 that changes subword boundaries for rare tokens. Also enabled the greedy chunker to reduce token count for some inputs — possible segmentation + KV-cache alignment issue on long contexts.

jordan: Infra metrics: cluster p95 +1.2s, p99 +6.8s in us-west-2 the last 20m. pod-ml-3 queueing spiked; autoscaler tried to provision nodes but hit capacity errors. Also saw backlog on request-queue while retries retried auth failures.

sarah: Quick mitigation idea: pin affected tenants to nebula-v1.1 or route them to nebula-compat. We can also flip tokenizer_compat=true for a fallback.

alex: Agreed. Mitigations to run now: 1) pin bluehawk & acme to nebula-v1.1 2) enable tokenizer_compat flag for those routes 3) rollback tokenizer change from canary -> full if canary still has issue. I'll open the routing change PR.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for nebula tokenizer change (canary) - deploy id d-9912 - started 4165432140

deploy-bot: rollback complete - deploy id d-9912 - status: success - finished 4165432146

eli: Update: bluehawk p99 back to baseline within ~4m after rollback/pinning. acme partial improvement, still seeing 1.5s p99 delta. 504s gone. The billing/auth errors were unrelated for one tenant — turned out to be rotated service keys; customer fixed on their side.

maya: Preliminary root cause: tokenizer emitted different segmentation which caused KV-cache offsets to be off for some long sequences. That triggered the long-context slowpath and extra token recomputation. Combined with node provisioning delay -> p99 spike.

jordan: Follow-ups for infra: open INF-2026 to request extra capacity buffer in us-west-2, add autoscaler retry backoff adjustment, and add more visibility into queue depth per-tenant.

sarah: I'll create a customer-facing support note and update the status page. Tagging @ops-runbook for playbook updates (tokenizer regressions runbook).

ops-runbook: Acknowledged. Will add steps: 1) pin tenant routing 2) flip tokenizer_compat 3) revert canary 4) request infra capacity.

eli: Thanks team. I'll file a postmortem ticket with timeline and attach the request traces + profiler outputs. Will follow up with customers once we have final RCA. :white_check_mark:
